description: Input with pull-up read every 500 ms; the pin is pulled to LOW at 700 ms (the same example on the Nano).
basis: the output of the example on the Uno (class derived: derived by hand from the sketch source (C++ semantics, avr-gcc: int is 16 bit) and the 'Beobachtung' comment of the example; datasheet 14.2.3: INPUT_PULLUP reads HIGH, an outside LOW wins) holds for the Nano: it has the ATmega328P of the Uno at 16 MHz, the pins 0 to 19 are numbered alike (A0 = 14, pins_arduino.h of the eightanaloginputs variant) and the sketch uses neither A6 nor A7; no recording on a Nano exists
